units.summary: New helper returning whether a series has no OOO state; used as a predicate in filtering and eviction.
units.headline: Adds helper reporting whether a series has no OOO data
units.reason: Trivial predicate extracted from existing inline check; behavior equivalent.

units.summary: Extracts the existing stale-NaN check (float, histogram, float histogram) into a helper, same logic as the removed inline code.
units.headline: Extracts stale-NaN series check into helper
units.reason: Logic is identical to the previously inlined condition.

units.summary: truncateStaleSeries now delegates to truncateSeries with a predicate requiring no OOO, still stale, and no appendID above the watermark. The new watermark skips series that got late samples.
units.headline: Stale truncation now also skips series with post-watermark appends or OOO
units.reason: Changes which series are evicted and the function signature; eviction can cause data loss if wrong.
focus: Watermark capture timing in compactHeadViewLocked relative to block write
Skipped series are retained consistently with WAL tombstones (only deleted refs are tombstoned)

units.summary: New eviction entry point for caller-selected series, skipping those with OOO data or appendIDs above the watermark.
units.headline: New eviction for selected series with OOO and watermark guards
units.reason: New eviction path that deletes head data; correctness of guards matters.
focus: Predicate re-checks OOO under lock at eviction time
Watermark semantics with isolation disabled (guard becomes no-op)

units.summary: Checks the series' isolation tx ring for any appendID above a watermark, to avoid evicting series with samples not in the generated block. No-op when isolation is disabled.
units.headline: Adds appendID watermark check to protect late appends from eviction
units.reason: Core data-safety guard relying on the isolation ring buffer; wrong logic means lost samples.
focus: Ring iteration over txIDCount entries is correct for wrapped rings
Isolation-disabled mode silently loses late samples, as the test documents
Cleaned-up txIDs below the isolation low-water mark cannot hide post-watermark appends

units.summary: Generalizes the stale truncation into truncateSeries taking an eviction predicate, and returns the number of evicted series. WAL tombstones are recorded only for deleted refs.
units.headline: Generalizes truncation with per-series eviction predicate
units.reason: Shared eviction/WAL tombstone path now parameterized; mistakes affect data durability.
focus: Tombstones written only for refs actually deleted
Early return when MinTime >= maxt returns 0 without error for both callers

units.reason: Signature adaptation only; MaxUint64 disables the watermark guard, preserving test intent.
